brief:
Deterrence Force, an armed group affiliated with resistance security services, released video recordings of individuals returning from a camp operated by armed gangs in northern Gaza, Shehab Wire reported. The footage showed multiple people departing the militia compound in the territory's north.

The group, known as Radaa, documented what it characterized as defectors leaving the facility. The recordings were distributed as part of what the force presented as evidence of individuals abandoning the armed gangs' operations. Radaa has conducted various security operations across Gaza in recent periods, though the exact circumstances and timeline of these particular defections remained unclear from the available information.
